description: This colorful window is from the Avery Coonley Playhouse, a small structure Frank Lloyd Wright designed as an addition to the Coonley family's suburban Chicago estate, which he previously completed in 1908. Wright explored the use of glass both as a transparent screen uniting exterior and interior and as a decorative element. Here, the colors and design anticipate the later abstractions of Piet Mondrian.
title: Triptych Window from the Coonley Playhouse, Riverside, Illinois
